root_cause: finalizer.py build_finalizer_prompt() sets payload['required_format'] = ['Summary', 'Evidence used', 'Actions performed', ...] which instructs the LLM to produce structured sections. The LLM complies and outputs '## Summary', '## Finalización de Ejecución Agent V2', 'I'll finalize this Agent V2 run...', etc. These reach the user via dashboard_routes.py:368 content = data.get('final_answer').
flow: finalizer.py prompt → LLM → answer → langgraph_parity_runtime state['final_answer'] → response_normalizer.py (identity guard only, no boilerplate strip) → api_adapter.py final_answer → dashboard_routes.py content → UI
leak_patterns: ## Finalización de Ejecución Agent V2 — Diagnóstico
I'll finalize this Agent V2 run
This is an evidence-required diagnosis run
This is a read-only evidence diagnosis run
generated_by: LLM following finalizer prompt template instructions (required_format array)
not_generated_by: deterministic fallback (that path produces different structured text), response_normalizer (it only does identity guard), provider directly (provider just follows the prompt)
useful_as_metadata: yes — the structured sections are useful for trace/inspector but bad as user-facing content
fix_location: response_normalizer.py — add sanitize_user_facing_content() that strips finalizer boilerplate preambles from final_answer before it reaches the chat UI
fix_approach: conservative pattern-based stripper that removes known finalizer section headers and framing sentences while preserving actual answer paragraphs, code blocks, safety refusals, and legitimate markdown
